reference_sql:
WITH months AS (
  -- one row per month from June to September 2025; June gives July its starting MRR
  SELECT DISTINCT month
  FROM mrr_monthly
  WHERE month >= DATE '2025-06-01'
    AND month <= DATE '2025-09-01'
),
accounts_in_window AS (
  -- one row per account with MRR on the last day of at least one of those months
  SELECT DISTINCT account_id
  FROM mrr_monthly
  WHERE month >= DATE '2025-06-01'
    AND month <= DATE '2025-09-01'
),
filled AS (
  -- one row per account and month, with 0 for a month without MRR
  SELECT a.account_id,
         m.month,
         COALESCE(r.mrr_eur, 0) AS mrr
  FROM accounts_in_window AS a
  CROSS JOIN months AS m
  LEFT JOIN mrr_monthly AS r
    ON r.account_id = a.account_id
   AND r.month = m.month
),
compared AS (
  -- one row per account and month, with its MRR at the end of the month before
  SELECT account_id,
         month,
         mrr,
         LAG(mrr) OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY month) AS mrr_before
  FROM filled
),
new_accounts AS (
  -- one row per account and month in which its first subscription started
  SELECT DISTINCT account_id,
         CAST(date_trunc('month', event_date) AS DATE) AS month
  FROM subscription_events
  WHERE event_type = 'new'
)
SELECT c.month,
       SUM(c.mrr_before) AS starting_mrr,
       SUM(CASE WHEN c.mrr_before = 0 AND c.mrr > 0 AND n.account_id IS NOT NULL THEN c.mrr ELSE 0 END) AS new_mrr,
       SUM(CASE WHEN c.mrr_before > 0 AND c.mrr > c.mrr_before THEN c.mrr - c.mrr_before ELSE 0 END) AS expansion_mrr,
       SUM(CASE WHEN c.mrr_before = 0 AND c.mrr > 0 AND n.account_id IS NULL THEN c.mrr ELSE 0 END) AS reactivation_mrr,
       SUM(CASE WHEN c.mrr_before > 0 AND c.mrr > 0 AND c.mrr < c.mrr_before THEN c.mrr - c.mrr_before ELSE 0 END) AS contraction_mrr,
       SUM(CASE WHEN c.mrr_before > 0 AND c.mrr = 0 THEN -c.mrr_before ELSE 0 END) AS churn_mrr,
       SUM(c.mrr) AS ending_mrr
FROM compared AS c
LEFT JOIN new_accounts AS n
  ON n.account_id = c.account_id
 AND n.month = c.month
WHERE c.month >= DATE '2025-07-01'
GROUP BY c.month
ORDER BY c.month

WITH this_month AS (
  -- one row per account with MRR at the end of a month from July to September 2025
  SELECT account_id, month, mrr_eur
  FROM mrr_monthly
  WHERE month >= DATE '2025-07-01'
    AND month <= DATE '2025-09-01'
),
month_before AS (
  -- one row per account with MRR at the end of a month from June to August 2025, dated to the month after
  SELECT account_id,
         CAST(month + INTERVAL 1 MONTH AS DATE) AS month,
         mrr_eur
  FROM mrr_monthly
  WHERE month >= DATE '2025-06-01'
    AND month <= DATE '2025-08-01'
),
pairs AS (
  -- one row per account and month with MRR at the end of that month or of the month before
  SELECT COALESCE(t.account_id, b.account_id) AS account_id,
         COALESCE(t.month, b.month) AS month,
         COALESCE(b.mrr_eur, 0) AS mrr_before,
         COALESCE(t.mrr_eur, 0) AS mrr
  FROM this_month AS t
  FULL OUTER JOIN month_before AS b
    ON b.account_id = t.account_id
   AND b.month = t.month
),
labelled AS (
  -- one row per account and month, with the movement it makes
  SELECT p.month,
         p.mrr_before,
         p.mrr,
         CASE WHEN p.mrr_before = 0 AND EXISTS (
                     SELECT 1
                     FROM subscription_events AS e
                     WHERE e.account_id = p.account_id
                       AND e.event_type = 'new'
                       AND CAST(date_trunc('month', e.event_date) AS DATE) = p.month) THEN 'new'
              WHEN p.mrr_before = 0 THEN 'reactivation'
              WHEN p.mrr = 0 THEN 'churn'
              WHEN p.mrr > p.mrr_before THEN 'expansion'
              WHEN p.mrr < p.mrr_before THEN 'contraction'
              ELSE 'none' END AS movement
  FROM pairs AS p
)
SELECT month,
       SUM(mrr_before) AS starting_mrr,
       SUM(CASE WHEN movement = 'new' THEN mrr ELSE 0 END) AS new_mrr,
       SUM(CASE WHEN movement = 'expansion' THEN mrr - mrr_before ELSE 0 END) AS expansion_mrr,
       SUM(CASE WHEN movement = 'reactivation' THEN mrr ELSE 0 END) AS reactivation_mrr,
       SUM(CASE WHEN movement = 'contraction' THEN mrr - mrr_before ELSE 0 END) AS contraction_mrr,
       SUM(CASE WHEN movement = 'churn' THEN -mrr_before ELSE 0 END) AS churn_mrr,
       SUM(mrr) AS ending_mrr
FROM labelled
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month

WITH months AS (
  -- one row per month from June to September 2025
  SELECT CAST(d AS DATE) AS month
  FROM generate_series(DATE '2025-06-01', DATE '2025-09-01', INTERVAL 1 MONTH) AS g(d)
),
filled AS (
  -- one row per account and month, with 0 for a month without MRR
  SELECT a.account_id,
         m.month,
         COALESCE(r.mrr_eur, 0) AS mrr
  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT account_id FROM mrr_monthly) AS a
  CROSS JOIN months AS m
  LEFT JOIN mrr_monthly AS r
    ON r.account_id = a.account_id
   AND r.month = m.month
),
compared AS (
  -- one row per account and month from July to September 2025, with its MRR at the end of the month before
  SELECT cur.account_id,
         cur.month,
         cur.mrr,
         prev.mrr AS mrr_before,
         CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1
                           FROM subscription_events AS e
                           WHERE e.account_id = cur.account_id
                             AND e.event_type = 'new'
                             AND e.event_date >= cur.month
                             AND e.event_date < CAST(cur.month + INTERVAL 1 MONTH AS DATE)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new
  FROM filled AS cur
  JOIN filled AS prev
    ON prev.account_id = cur.account_id
   AND prev.month = CAST(cur.month - INTERVAL 1 MONTH AS DATE)
)
SELECT month,
       SUM(mrr_before) AS starting_mrr,
       SUM(CASE WHEN mrr_before = 0 AND mrr > 0 AND is_new = 1 THEN mrr ELSE 0 END) AS new_mrr,
       SUM(CASE WHEN mrr_before > 0 AND mrr > mrr_before THEN mrr - mrr_before ELSE 0 END) AS expansion_mrr,
       SUM(CASE WHEN mrr_before = 0 AND mrr > 0 AND is_new = 0 THEN mrr ELSE 0 END) AS reactivation_mrr,
       SUM(CASE WHEN mrr_before > 0 AND mrr > 0 AND mrr < mrr_before THEN mrr - mrr_before ELSE 0 END) AS contraction_mrr,
       SUM(CASE WHEN mrr_before > 0 AND mrr = 0 THEN -mrr_before ELSE 0 END) AS churn_mrr,
       SUM(mrr) AS ending_mrr
FROM compared
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month

solver.query:
WITH months AS (
  SELECT DATE '2025-07-01' AS month UNION ALL SELECT DATE '2025-08-01' UNION ALL SELECT DATE '2025-09-01'
), base AS (
  SELECT m.month, p.account_id FROM months m JOIN mrr_monthly p ON p.month = CAST(m.month - INTERVAL 1 MONTH AS DATE)
  UNION
  SELECT m.month, c.account_id FROM months m JOIN mrr_monthly c ON c.month = m.month
), a AS (
  SELECT b.month, b.account_id,
         COALESCE(p.mrr_eur, 0) AS prev, COALESCE(c.mrr_eur, 0) AS cur,
         EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM subscription_events e
                 WHERE e.account_id = b.account_id AND e.event_type = 'new'
                   AND e.event_date >= b.month AND e.event_date < CAST(b.month + INTERVAL 1 MONTH AS DATE)) AS is_new
  FROM base b
  LEFT JOIN mrr_monthly p ON p.account_id = b.account_id AND p.month = CAST(b.month - INTERVAL 1 MONTH AS DATE)
  LEFT JOIN mrr_monthly c ON c.account_id = b.account_id AND c.month = b.month
)

SELECT month,
       SUM(prev) AS starting_mrr,
       COALESCE(SUM(cur) FILTER (WHERE prev = 0 AND cur > 0 AND is_new), 0) AS new_mrr,
       COALESCE(SUM(cur - prev) FILTER (WHERE prev > 0 AND cur > prev), 0) AS expansion_mrr,
       COALESCE(SUM(cur) FILTER (WHERE prev = 0 AND cur > 0 AND NOT is_new), 0) AS reactivation_mrr,
       COALESCE(SUM(cur - prev) FILTER (WHERE prev > 0 AND cur > 0 AND cur < prev), 0) AS contraction_mrr,
       COALESCE(-SUM(prev) FILTER (WHERE prev > 0 AND cur = 0), 0) AS churn_mrr,
       SUM(cur) AS ending_mrr
FROM a
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month
